meta.description: Predict enhancer-gene regulatory connections from ATAC-seq using ABC, ENCODE-rE2G, HiChIP, or Cicero; choose contact-aware, accessibility-only or orthogonal approaches, threshold and validate predictions.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; unsupported claims (rE2G 1 Mb window, average of 10 cell types, catalog URL) are recorded as findings rather than invented results.

practice_boundaries.detail: Predictions are framed as hypotheses; therapeutic nomination requires experimental validation.

methodological_ground.detail: No principled fallacy: ABC and rE2G scores reproduced exactly by the upstream pipelines. Deviations (raw candidate peaks, missing qnorm, fixed thresholds, model choice by tissue) are filed as P1/P2 findings.

code_usability.detail: The only shipped script, scripts/run_abc.sh, crashes at predict.py (missing --accessibility_feature; avg Hi-C also needs --hic_gamma/--hic_scale) on ABC v1.1.2 and main; the needed patch is outside the audit-local repair budget.

functional_suitability.note: Matched-Hi-C path cannot run from the shipped script; rE2G model/threshold guidance and ATAC-only routing are inaccurate

reliability.note: set -euo pipefail only; hard failure at predict.py with no guard, no input checks, unquoted variables

performance_context.note: Lean SKILL.md with routed references; reference loaded on demand

agent_usability.note: Clear workflow and warnings, but conflicting normalization guidance, unusable snippet keys, and an agent cannot recover the crash from the Skill text

human_usability.note: Natural triggers and request examples; rigid hard-coded inputs and placeholder arguments

security.note: No secrets or destructive commands; unquoted shell variables and remote download suggestions without integrity checks

maintainability.note: Modular layout; script has hard-coded inputs, unused GENOME_FA, backtick-comment hack and no tests

agent_specific.note: Precise but long description, good routing and provenance disclaimer; stale version claims and no escape hatch when a pipeline step fails

key_strengths: The upstream ABC (v1.1.2 and main) and ENCODE-rE2G pipelines the Skill routes to reproduce the shipped expected chr22 tables exactly, and scores obey ABC invariants.
Method-selection table, cell-type-proxy warning and therapeutic-nomination rule (two methods plus CRISPRi validation) are scientifically sensible.
The Skill discloses unverified versions and hard-coded script inputs and routes depth to references.
Once patched, run_abc.sh produces coherent tracks, neighborhoods and a parseable score table; the standalone awk threshold snippet is correct.

recommendations.title: run_abc.sh crashes at predict.py
recommendations.problem: predict.py raises ValueError because --accessibility_feature is not passed; with --hic_type avg it also needs --hic_gamma and --hic_scale. The only shipped script fails deterministically on ABC v1.1.2 and main.
recommendations.root_cause: The script was written without running predict.py against a current ABC release.
recommendations.fix: Pass --accessibility_feature (ATAC or DHS) and the avg Hi-C gamma/scale (from ABC config) as documented arguments, then rerun the chr22 example end to end. (EGL-001)

recommendations.title: Matched Hi-C path not runnable from the script
recommendations.problem: The script hard-codes --hic_type avg and --hic_resolution 5000 and describes the Hi-C input as cooler or hic, but the primary documented workflow (matched Hi-C) needs --hic_type hic and predict.py has no cooler mode.
recommendations.root_cause: Script parameters are fixed instead of exposed.
recommendations.fix: Expose hic type, file and resolution as arguments, correct the comment, and test the hic branch. (EGL-002)

recommendations.title: Candidate regions differ from ABC method
recommendations.problem: Candidates are raw MACS peaks minus promoters (median 150 bp, max 10.7 Mb, no blacklist, no top-N); ABC uses summit-centred 500 bp regions. run_abc.sh gives 4x the official non-self links and recovers 63 percent of them.
recommendations.root_cause: SKILL.md step 3 and the script replace makeCandidateRegions with bedtools intersect -v.
recommendations.fix: Use ABC makeCandidateRegions.py (with blacklist and chrom sizes) or state the deviation and its cost. (EGL-003)

recommendations.title: ENCODE-rE2G model selection and threshold wrong
recommendations.problem: Pretrained models are keyed by assay and Hi-C type and the pipeline chooses them; there is no no-hic model or cell-type selection. Pipeline thresholds are 0.18-0.30 at 70 percent recall, not 0.5/0.8.
recommendations.root_cause: Guidance was written from memory of the preprint, not the repository.
recommendations.fix: Rewrite step 4 and the thresholds table from the repository models directory and threshold files. (EGL-004, EGL-005)

recommendations.title: ABC threshold ignores input-dependent calibration
recommendations.problem: Official ABC thresholds are automatic (0.013-0.027 in the chr22 runs) and depend on accessibility, H3K27ac and Hi-C type; the Skill uses a flat 0.02 and skips qnorm.
recommendations.root_cause: Single fixed cutoff copied from the original paper.
recommendations.fix: Point to reference/abc_thresholds.tsv and the pipeline's automatic threshold; keep 0.02 as a fallback with caveat. (EGL-005, EGL-006)

recommendations.title: Normalization guidance conflicts with script
recommendations.problem: Step 3 requires --qnorm, RPGC/RPM-IP scaling, but run.neighborhoods.py counts BAM reads and the script never passes --qnorm.
recommendations.root_cause: Tracks were retained from an earlier design.
recommendations.fix: State that qnorm is optional or add the argument with the reference file. (EGL-006)

recommendations.title: ATAC-only routes to Cicero, which needs scATAC
recommendations.problem: The method table sends bulk ATAC-only users to Cicero (single-cell), although ABC supports ATAC-only activity and has thresholds for it.
recommendations.root_cause: Data-availability table conflates bulk and single-cell inputs.
recommendations.fix: Split bulk and single-cell rows and allow ABC without H3K27ac. (EGL-007)

recommendations.title: Script arguments ignored and unquoted
recommendations.problem: atac_peaks.narrowPeak, promoter_regions.bed and ubiquitously_expressed.txt are hard-coded, GENOME_FA is unused, variables are unquoted, and comments sit in backticks.
recommendations.fix: Make inputs arguments, quote variables, remove unused slot. (EGL-008)

recommendations.title: Combine snippet uses nonexistent columns
recommendations.problem: Merge keys enhancer_id/gene raise KeyError; real outputs use name/TargetGene; hichip_anchors is a placeholder.
recommendations.root_cause: Snippet never run on real output.
recommendations.fix: Use name and TargetGene and either implement the HiChIP overlap or label it pseudocode. (EGL-009)

recommendations.title: Install commands stale
recommendations.problem: abcenv.yml does not solve today, monocle3 is not on Bioconductor, and unpinned pip install snakemake gives 9.x while ABC and rE2G need 7.x.
